title: Product/projection coherence for the proper external product
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-admissibility], with $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, write $a_X:X\to s$, $a_Y:Y\to s$, and take $K,V\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. All tensors and operations are derived over $A$ on these constructible domains. Set $K'=Rf_*K$, $Z_X=X\times_sX$, $Z_Y=Y\times_sY$, $U=Y\times_sX$, $q=f\times f$, $r=f\times\operatorname{id}_X:Z_X\to U$, $\pi:U\to Y$ the first projection, and let $p_i,p_i'$ denote the projections from $Z_X,Z_Y$. Use the exact maps $\operatorname{Ku}_!$ of [def-sf-kv-maps] and the projection transformations of [fix-prop-projection-formula]. Put $W=V\otimes f^*L$ and define
$$E_r(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,\operatorname{id}_X;K,B),\quad J_{Y,X}(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_X;K',B),$$
$$J_X(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_X,a_X;K,B),\quad J_Y(C)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_Y;K',C).$$
Let $T_L=Rp'_{1!}(Rq_*(K\boxtimes V)\otimes p_2'^*L)$. Define $F:T_L\to R\pi_!Rr_!(K\boxtimes W)$ by applying $Rp'_{1!}\operatorname{PF}_{q,K\boxtimes V,p_2'^*L}$, identifying $(K\boxtimes V)\otimes q^*p_2'^*L=K\boxtimes W$, and using $p'_1q=\pi r$. Define $G:T_L\to Rp'_{1!}(K'\boxtimes(Rf_*V\otimes L))$ by applying $Rp'_{1!}(\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,f;K,V)\otimes1_{p_2'^*L})$ and reassociating the external tensor factors. Then the following equality holds:
$$\bigl(1_{K'}\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{Y!}\operatorname{PF}_{f,V,L}\bigr)\circ J_Y(Rf_*V\otimes L)\circ G=J_{Y,X}(W)\circ R\pi_!E_r(W)\circ F.$$
The left target is identified with $K'\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{X!}W$ by compact-support composition. All composition comparisons and tensor constraints are the specified geometric comparisons, including their Koszul signs.

proof.text: Work at the fixed finite ring $A$ throughout. The maps $r=f\times1_X$ and $1_Y\times f$ are base changes of $f$; their composite is $q$, so they and $q$ are proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](a),(b). Use [prop-functor-package](3) to identify their compact-support and ordinary images, and to compose compact-support functors. By [thm-sf-ctf-stability](i)--(iv), all pullbacks, external products, $W$, $K'$, $Rf_*V$, $Rf_*W$, and their compact-support images lie in $D^b_{ctf}$. In particular the tensor unit $A_Y$, which is locally free of rank one in degree zero, is an allowed finite-Tor input. Put $P=\operatorname{PF}_{q,K\boxtimes V,p_2'^*L}$, including the monoidal identification of its target with $Rq_!(K\boxtimes W)$, and put $u=\operatorname{PF}_{f,V,L}:Rf_*V\otimes L\to Rf_*W$. These are the specified transformations of [fix-prop-projection-formula].

source.place: Step 3, proof of (a): “since ... mu_f and Pi_f are adjoint to epsilon_f tensor epsilon_f”; product/projection comparison expanded in returned item step 9

proof.text: For the first factor, the proper projection map $\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,A_Y}$ is the identity of $Rf_*K$ under the tensor-unit identifications. Indeed, [def-exchange-projection] defines its ordinary $f^*\dashv Rf_*$ transpose to be $\varepsilon_{f,K}\otimes1_{f^*A_Y}$ after the monoidal pullback comparison. Since $f^*A_Y=A_X$, its transpose is exactly $\varepsilon_{f,K}$; this is also the transpose of $1_{Rf_*K}$. The ordinary adjunction of [fix-prop-adjunctions](1) is a bijection on morphisms, so the maps coincide. The proper compact-support normalization agrees with this ordinary projection by [fix-prop-projection-formula].

source.place: Step 3, proof of (a): “since ... mu_f and Pi_f are adjoint to epsilon_f tensor epsilon_f”; product/projection comparison expanded in returned item step 9

proof.text:
Write $H=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,f;K,W)$ and $H_0=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,f;K,V)$. Apply [lem-sf-exterior-projection-kunneth] with $(f_1,f_2)=(f,f)$, $(M_1,M_2)=(K,V)$, and $(B_1,B_2)=(A_Y,L)$. Here $A_Y\boxtimes L=p_2'^*L$ and $(K\otimes f^*A_Y)\boxtimes(V\otimes f^*L)=K\boxtimes W$. The unit calculation in Step 2 removes the first-factor projection. Consequently, if $A_0:(Rq_!(K\boxtimes V))\otimes p_2'^*L\to K'\boxtimes(Rf_*V\otimes L)$ denotes $H_0\otimes1$ followed by the reassociation used in $G$, the cited equality is precisely
$$H\circ P=(1_{K'}\boxtimes u)\circ A_0.$$
All identifications here are the signed monoidal pullback comparisons of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]; the cited exterior-projection lemma uses the exact $\operatorname{Ku}_!$ construction specified by [def-sf-kv-maps](i).

source.place: Step 3, proof of (a): “since ... mu_f and Pi_f are adjoint to epsilon_f tensor epsilon_f”; product/projection comparison expanded in returned item step 9

proof.text:
The maps $\operatorname{Ku}_!$ of [def-sf-kv-maps](i) are natural in their coefficient objects: that definition constructs them from the relative product, which is natural in both objects by [thm-sf-kunneth-relative], and the natural compact-support exchanges. In particular apply this naturality to $J_Y$ and the morphism $u:Rf_*V\otimes L\to Rf_*W$ to get
$$(1_{K'}\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{Y!}u)\circ J_Y(Rf_*V\otimes L)
=J_Y(Rf_*W)\circ Rp'_{1!}(1_{K'}\boxtimes u).$$
Since $G=Rp'_{1!}A_0$, composing with $G$ and applying $Rp'_{1!}$ to Step 3 shows that the left side of the asserted equality is
$$J_Y(Rf_*W)\circ Rp'_{1!}H\circ Rp'_{1!}P.$$
Its target is $K'\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{Y!}Rf_!W$, with the proper identification for $f$ from Step 1.

source.place: Step 3, proof of (a): “since ... mu_f and Pi_f are adjoint to epsilon_f tensor epsilon_f”; product/projection comparison expanded in returned item step 9

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sf-kv-shriek-composition] to the two factorwise chains $(X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow{1}Y,\ X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow{a_Y}s)$ and to the objects $(K,W)$. Since $a_Yf=a_X$, its displayed equation gives
$$J_Y(Rf_*W)\circ Rp'_{1!}H=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,a_X;K,W).$$
Apply the same node instead to $(X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow{1}Y,\ X\xrightarrow{1}X\xrightarrow{a_X}s)$. Its equation gives
$$\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,a_X;K,W)=J_{Y,X}(W)\circ R\pi_!E_r(W).$$
These are equalities from $R(p'_1q)_!(K\boxtimes W)=R(\pi r)_!(K\boxtimes W)$ to $K'\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{X!}W$. The composition and identity identifications are the specified ones in that node, with the associative compact-support composition of [prop-functor-package](3). Thus both factorizations use the same comparison, including the target identification $Ra_{Y!}Rf_!W=Ra_{X!}W$.

proof.text:
Substitute the two equalities of Step 5 into the final composite of Step 4. This gives
$$J_{Y,X}(W)\circ R\pi_!E_r(W)\circ Rp'_{1!}P.$$
Under $p'_1q=\pi r$, the last factor, with the target composition comparison inserted, is exactly $F$ by its definition in the statement. The resulting expression is the asserted right side. Every tensor symmetry was the specified signed symmetry in Step 3; subsequent steps used only functoriality, naturality and the specified composition equations, so no additional sign is introduced.
